ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: If the chicken went extinct, what would happen to the amount of corn?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a food/production chain. Sunlight points respectively to maize plant and wheat plant. Maize plant points downward to “Corn for feeding chicken”, and then these corns are used to feed Chicken. Chicken further points to chicken pizza through “Chicken meat used in making”. Reasoning: Because the use of corn in the figure is to feed chickens, if chickens became extinct, there would be no chickens to eat these corns. Therefore the corn consumed by chickens would decrease, and the amount of remaining corn would increase.
